# Growthbook x Mistral - Roadmap / Technical Questions
Date: 2026-09-09 | Duration: 61.81999969482422m

## Summary
Growth Book is evolving toward AI-driven experimentation at scale through API-accessible UI functions, Slack workflows, proactive AI agents, and a comprehensive skill library covering hypothesis generation, setup, monitoring, interpretation, and learning capture. The teams discussed integrating Growth Book with Vibe and Mistral’s DBT semantic layer while maintaining authoritative metric definitions, directionality, and metadata. Backend improvements such as incremental refresh and pre-aggregation aim to support high traffic and complex metrics. Mistral highlighted operational friction, including long-running experiments with limited visibility, slow metric slicing, cluttered metric management, unclear feature-flag draft and published states, weak filtering, onboarding challenges, and insufficient SDK documentation. Growth Book identified project-scoped metric groups and data sources for the 5.1 release later this month, and discussed approval flows, warnings, AI monitoring, and better navigation. Additional feedback covered SQL transparency, sequential-testing p-values, confidence-interval visualization, Slack support, enablement sessions, and recurring technical syncs.

## Keywords
Experimentation, AI agent, Feature Flags, Metrics Management, Semantic Layer, User Onboarding

## Action Items

Facilitate enablement sessions planning with Mistral engineering teams (51:00)
